pass_1.finding: The manual explicitly lists E3390/E3392 and E3400–E3408 sets, names E8015 as a compatible library-prep kit, and prints per-well expected eight-base i7 and i5 index reads. Set 2A and 2B are subsets of Set 2, so they should not be pooled with it. These expected index reads do not identify the chosen well or print the complete primer synthesis strands.
